hotwire.not_driver: You need to be in the driver's seat.
hotwire.has_keys: You have the keys to this vehicle.
hotwire.timeout: The server didn't respond, try again.
hotwire.missing_models: The hotwire props failed to load.
hotwire.hint_screws: Hold LMB on a screw and circle the mouse counter-clockwise, following the ring
hotwire.hint_probe: Hold LMB on a wire to test it
hotwire.hint_strippers: Grab the end of a wire and pull down slowly to strip it
hotwire.hint_twist: Drag the Steady (battery) wire onto the Pulsing (ignition) wire to twist them
hotwire.hint_crank: Hold the Flickering (starter) wire on the twist and let go in the green
hotwire.next_strip: All three wires found. Strip them next
hotwire.rewired: Battery and ignition are still twisted. Touch the starter to the twist
hotwire.legend: Steady = battery  ·  Pulsing = ignition  ·  Flickering = starter
hotwire.failed: You botched the wiring. The alarm is going off!

lockpick.no_lock: There's no door lock within reach.
lockpick.wrong_vehicle: You can't pick this vehicle's lock.
lockpick.too_far: You're too far from the door.
lockpick.occupied: Someone is in the driver's seat.
lockpick.jammed: A broken pick tip is stuck in this lock.
lockpick.has_keys: You have the keys to this vehicle.
lockpick.moved_away: You moved away from the door.
lockpick.timeout: The server didn't respond, try again.
lockpick.missing_models: The lockpick props failed to load.
lockpick.hint_tension: Hold RMB to put light turning tension on the lock
lockpick.hint_feel: Hold LMB and push the mouse up to lift a wafer. Find the stiff one: that one binds
lockpick.hint_next: Lift the stiff wafer slowly until it clicks. Then find the next one
lockpick.hint_jammed: A wafer is overset. Let go of RMB to release the tension and start over
lockpick.opened: The lock turns. The door is unlocked.
lockpick.failed: Your pick snapped in the lock. The alarm is going off!

siphon.no_filler: Stand at a car's fuel filler.
siphon.in_vehicle: Get out of the vehicle first.
siphon.electric: Electric cars have no fuel to siphon.
siphon.too_far: You're too far from the car.
siphon.occupied: Someone is in the driver's seat.
siphon.locked: The car is locked. The fuel door opens from inside.
siphon.no_can: You need a jerry can with room in it.
siphon.no_fuel_info: Couldn't read the car's fuel, try again.
siphon.vehicle_moved: The car moved. The fuel spilled.
siphon.moved_away: You moved away. The fuel spilled.
siphon.engine_started: Someone started the engine. The fuel spilled.
siphon.timeout: The server didn't respond, try again.
siphon.missing_models: The siphon props failed to load.
siphon.hint_blow: Hold LMB to blow into the hose
siphon.hint_release: Let go in the green zone
siphon.hint_prime: Puff by puff, push the fuel up the hose
siphon.hint_flow: The fuel is running. Press E to pull the hose
siphon.gulp: Too hard! A mouthful of fuel
siphon.siphoned: You siphoned {n} litres. The can is {can}% full.
siphon.nothing: No fuel made it into the can.
siphon.gave_up: You give up, coughing up fuel.
siphon.siphoned_spilled: You siphoned {n} litres ({spilled} litres spilled). The can is {can}% full.
siphon.all_spilled: All {spilled} litres ended up on the ground.
siphon.hint_place: Where do you put the jerry can?
siphon.place_sub: On flat ground by the car, within reach of the hose
siphon.spot_far: Too far from the filler: the hose won't reach
siphon.spot_legs: Your legs will be there while you work: put it further out
siphon.hint_cancap: Unscrew the can's cap: hold LMB on it and circle counter-clockwise
siphon.hint_funnel: Drag the funnel over the can's neck and let it drop in
siphon.hint_fillercap: Unscrew the fuel cap: hold LMB on it and circle counter-clockwise
siphon.hint_hose: Click the end of the siphon hose to put it in the filler
siphon.hint_feed: Feeding the hose down the filler neck into the fuel
siphon.in_fuel: You hear it reach the fuel
siphon.hint_canhose: Click the other end of the hose to put it in the jerry can
siphon.hint_blowhose: Click the blow hose to put it in the filler too
siphon.hint_backing_up: The can is full: the funnel is filling up. Press E to pull the hose
siphon.hint_overflow: The funnel is running over! Press E to pull the hose
siphon.backing_up: The can is full. It's backing up into the funnel!
siphon.dry: Air comes through: the tank is down to the last of it
siphon.hint_fillercapon: Put the fuel cap back on
siphon.hint_screw_on: Hold LMB on the cap and circle clockwise until it clicks
siphon.hint_canout: Click the hose to pull it out of the can
siphon.hint_funnelout: Pull the funnel out of the can (S, or drag up)
